title: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines Under $100
h1: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines Under $100
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for sous vide machines under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at sous vide machines under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Instant Pot Accu Slim Sous Vide Immersion Circulator, 800W
products.blurb: Key specs: 800W heating element, Typically $70 to $80, Onboard touchscreen, no app required.
strengths: The lowest real-world price of any circulator in this list without sacrificing a usable onboard display
Clamps directly to an Instant Pot inner pot if you already own one
limitations: No app or WiFi features at all
800W is slower to recover than 1100W competitors on large batches
203°F max temperature is adequate for sous vide but limits any higher-temp uses
features: Clamps to 6 or 8-quart Instant Pot inner pot or any stockpot

products.name: KitchenBoss Sous Vide Cooker G321, 1100W
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W brushless DC motor, Typically $75 to $90, Built-in TFT display with preset recipes.
strengths: 1100W recovery power for close to the same price as 800W competitors
Built-in display with recipe presets, no app requirement
Quiet brushless motor is a genuine upgrade over older-style circulator motors
limitations: Smaller brand with less long-term reliability history than Instant Pot or Anova
Fewer total ratings than the more established competitors
No app for remote monitoring or saved custom presets
features: Built-in TFT display with preset recipes

products.name: Monoprice Strata Home Sous Vide Immersion Cooker, 1100W
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W brushless motor, Typically $65 to $75, Touch control interface.
strengths: Often the lowest price of any circulator in this list while still hitting 1100W
Simple touch controls with no learning curve
IPX7 waterproof rating matches pricier competitors
limitations: Least established brand reputation among the picks in this list
Mixed build-quality feedback compared to Instant Pot or Anova

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
